text: {"label":"Treatment Integrity, Selection, and Comparison","definition":"Work on how faithfully behavioral treatments are implemented and how treatments are evaluated and chosen, including integrity errors, alternating treatments designs, treatment preference and acceptability, and maintenance of treatment effects.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on implementation fidelity and methods for comparing and selecting treatments, rather than describing intervention programs, clinical service delivery and ethics, or clinical behavior analysis and psychotherapy."}
